        "Enter password {{admin_password}} into field login-password",
        "Click button login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 response with Location header /dashboard",
        "Set HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie named session",
        "Dashboard page contains element user-role with text admin"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""

    {
      "id": "LOGIN-002",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Viewer login succeeds with email case variation and surrounding whitespace",
      "coverage_area": "valid login",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset"],
      "test_data": {"email":"  Viewer@TESTMU.LOCAL  ","password":"{{viewer_password}}"},
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email \"  Viewer@TESTMU.LOCAL  \" into field login-email",
        "Enter password {{viewer_password}} into field login-password",
        "Click button login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 response with Location header /dashboard",
        "Set HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie named session",
        "Dashboard page contains element user-role with text viewer"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-003",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Login fails with incorrect password for admin",
      "coverage_area": "invalid credentials",
      "type": "negative",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset"],
      "test_data": {"email":"admin@testmu.local","password":"wrongpass"},
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email admin@testmu.local into field login-email",
        "Enter password wrongpass into field login-password",
        "Click button login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 401 response",
        "Element login-error contains text \"Invalid email or password.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-004",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "After a failed login attempt, admin can still sign in with correct password",
      "coverage_area": "invalid credentials",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset"],
      "test_data": {"email":"admin@testmu.local","wrong_password":"wrongpass","correct_password":"{{admin_password}}"},
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email admin@testmu.local into field login-email",
        "Enter password wrongpass into field login-password",
        "Click button login-submit",
        "Verify HTTP 401 and login-error message",
        "Enter password {{admin_password}} into field login-password",
        "Click button login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 response with Location header /dashboard",
        "Set HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie named session",
        "Dashboard page contains element user-role with text admin"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-005",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Existing user receives reset email and can set a new password",
      "coverage_area": "forgot password",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P0",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset"],
      "test_data": {"email":"admin@testmu.local","new_password":"NewPass123"},
      "steps": [
        "GET /forgot-password",
        "Enter email admin@testmu.local into field forgot-email",
        "Click button forgot-submit",
        "Verify element forgot-confirmation contains text \"If an account exists for that email, we've sent a password reset link.\"",
        "GET /_test/outbox?to=admin@testmu.local",
        "Extract reset token from the email link",
        "Navigate to reset-password?token=<extracted_token>",
        "Enter new password NewPass123 into field reset-password",
        "Enter new password NewPass123 into field reset-confirm-password",
        "Click button reset-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 response with Location header /login?reason=reset",
        "Login page shows element login-notice with text \"Your password has been updated. Please sign in.\"",
        "Subsequent login with new password succeeds with HTTP 303 to /dashboard"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-006",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Forgot password request for unknown email shows generic confirmation and sends no email",
      "coverage_area": "forgot password",
      "type": "negative",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset"],
      "test_data": {"email":"unknown@testmu.local"},
      "steps": [
        "GET /forgot-password",
        "Enter email unknown@testmu.local into field forgot-email",
        "Click button forgot-submit",
        "Verify element forgot-confirmation contains text \"If an account exists for that email, we've sent a password reset link.\"",
        "GET /_test/outbox?to=unknown@testmu.local"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "Forgot confirmation message is displayed",
        "Outbox request returns empty list, confirming no email was sent"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-007",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Reset link expires after 30 minutes and returns invalid link error",
      "coverage_area": "forgot password",
      "type": "boundary",
      "priority": "P2",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset","GET /forgot-password","Enter email admin@testmu.local into field forgot-email","Click button forgot-submit","GET /_test/outbox?to=admin@testmu.local","Extract reset token"],
      "test_data": {"token":"<extracted_token>"},
      "steps": [
        "POST /_test/clock with {\"advance_seconds\":1801}",
        "Navigate to reset-password?token=<extracted_token>",
        "Enter new password NewPass123 into field reset-password",
        "Enter new password NewPass123 into field reset-confirm-password",
        "Click button reset-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 400 response",
        "Element reset-error contains text \"This reset link is invalid or has expired.\"",
        "Reset form is not displayed"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-008",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Reset token cannot be reused after successful password change",
      "coverage_area": "forgot password",
      "type": "security",
      "priority": "P2",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset","GET /forgot-password","Enter email admin@testmu.local into field forgot-email","Click button forgot-submit","GET /_test/outbox?to=admin@testmu.local","Extract reset token"],
      "test_data": {"token":"<extracted_token>","new_password":"NewPass123"},
      "steps": [
        "Navigate to reset-password?token=<extracted_token>",
        "Enter new password NewPass123 into field reset-password",
        "Enter new password NewPass123 into field reset-confirm-password",
        "Click button reset-submit",
        "Navigate again to reset-password?token=<extracted_token>",
        "Enter new password AnotherPass123 into field reset-password",
        "Enter new password AnotherPass123 into field reset-confirm-password",
        "Click button reset-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "First reset returns HTTP 303 to /login?reason=reset",
        "Second attempt returns HTTP 400 response",
        "Element reset-error contains text \"This reset link is invalid or has expired.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-009",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Authenticated session within TTL allows access to dashboard",
      "coverage_area": "session expiry",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P0",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset","GET /login","Enter email admin@testmu.local into field login-email","Enter password {{admin_password}} into field login-password","Click button login-submit"],
      "test_data": {},
      "steps": [
        "POST /_test/clock with {\"advance_seconds\":600}",
        "GET /dashboard with session cookie"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 200 response",
        "Dashboard page contains element user-role with text admin"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-010",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Session expires after 30 minutes and redirects to login with expired notice",
      "coverage_area": "session expiry",
      "type": "negative",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset","GET /login","Enter email admin@testmu.local into field login-email","Enter password {{admin_password}} into field login-password","Click button login-submit"],
      "test_data": {},
      "steps": [
        "POST /_test/clock with {\"advance_seconds\":1801}",
        "GET /dashboard with session cookie"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 redirect to /login?reason=expired",
        "Login page shows element login-notice with text \"Your session has expired. Please sign in again.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-011",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Session exactly at expiration boundary is considered expired",
      "coverage_area": "session expiry",
      "type": "boundary",
      "priority": "P2",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset","GET /login","Enter email admin@testmu.local into field login-email","Enter password {{admin_password}} into field login-password","Click button login-submit"],
      "test_data": {},
      "steps": [
        "POST /_test/clock with {\"advance_seconds\":1800}",
        "GET /dashboard with session cookie"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 redirect to /login?reason=expired",
        "Login page shows element login-notice with text \"Your session has expired. Please sign in again.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-012",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Five consecutive failed logins on existing account trigger lockout on fifth attempt",
      "coverage_area": "brute-force lockout",
      "type": "boundary",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset"],
      "test_data": {"email":"admin@testmu.local","wrong_password":"badpass"},
      "steps": [
        "Repeat 5 times: GET /login, Enter email admin@testmu.local into field login-email, Enter password badpass into field login-password, Click button login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "Attempts 1-4 return HTTP 401 with login-error \"Invalid email or password.\"",
        "Attempt 5 returns HTTP 423 response",
        "Element login-error contains text \"Your account is locked after too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again later.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-013",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "During lockout, correct password still returns lockout message",
      "coverage_area": "brute-force lockout",
      "type": "security",
      "priority": "P0",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset","Perform 5 failed login attempts to lock account"],
      "test_data": {"email":"admin@testmu.local","password":"{{admin_password}}"},
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email admin@testmu.local into field login-email",
        "Enter password {{admin_password}} into field login-password",
        "Click button login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 423 response",
        "Element login-error contains text \"Your account is locked after too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again later.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-014",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "After lockout period ends, user can sign in successfully",
      "coverage_area": "brute-force lockout",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset","Perform 5 failed login attempts to lock account","POST /_test/clock with {\"advance_seconds\":901}"],
      "test_data": {"email":"admin@testmu.local","password":"{{admin_password}}"},
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email admin@testmu.local into field login-email",
        "Enter password {{admin_password}} into field login-password",
        "Click button login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 303 redirect to /dashboard",
        "Dashboard page contains element user-role with text admin"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-015",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Successful login resets failure counter so subsequent failed attempts start from one",
      "coverage_area": "brute-force lockout",
      "type": "positive",
      "priority": "P2",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset"],
      "test_data": {"email":"admin@testmu.local","wrong_password":"bad1","correct_password":"{{admin_password}}"},
      "steps": [
        "Perform 3 failed login attempts with wrong_password",
        "Perform successful login with correct_password",
        "Perform another failed login attempt with wrong_password"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "First three attempts return HTTP 401 each",
        "Successful login returns HTTP 303 to /dashboard",
        "Subsequent failed attempt returns HTTP 401 (not lockout)"
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-016",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Login with empty email and password fields returns generic invalid credentials error",
      "coverage_area": "invalid credentials",
      "type": "negative",
      "priority": "P1",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset"],
      "test_data": {},
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Leave field login-email empty",
        "Leave field login-password empty",
        "Click button login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 401 response",
        "Element login-error contains text \"Invalid email or password.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    },
    {
      "id": "LOGIN-017",
      "module": "login",
      "title": "Login attempt with SQL injection string in email is treated as plain data and fails without enumeration",
      "coverage_area": "invalid credentials",
      "type": "security",
      "priority": "P2",
      "preconditions": ["POST /_test/reset"],
      "test_data": {"email":"' OR '1'='1","password":"any"},
      "steps": [
        "GET /login",
        "Enter email ' OR '1'='1 into field login-email",
        "Enter password any into field login-password",
        "Click button login-submit"
      ],
      "expected_results": [
        "HTTP 401 response",
        "Element login-error contains text \"Invalid email or password.\""
      ],
      "automation_candidate": true,
      "notes": ""
    }
  ],
  "coverage_map": {
    "valid login": ["LOGIN-001","LOGIN-002"],
    "invalid credentials": ["LOGIN-003","LOGIN-004","LOGIN-016","LOGIN-017"],
    "forgot password": ["LOGIN-005","LOGIN-006","LOGIN-007","LOGIN-008"],
    "session expiry": ["LOGIN-009","LOGIN-010","LOGIN-011"],
    "brute-force lockout": ["LOGIN-012","LOGIN-013","LOGIN-014","LOGIN-015"]
  },
  "open_questions": []
}
